childReport.diffSummary: Read-only diagnosis; no files modified. Reviewed commit 54a5dc68 spec-hw-slot-ownership implementation (src/hal0/config/schema.py, src/hal0/config/loader.py, src/hal0/config/migrations/hw_slot_ownership.py, src/hal0/config/data/seed_profiles.toml) and grouped 123 CI failures into stale-test buckets with exact file paths.
reviewFindings: Decision: keep ProfileConfig.image REMOVED. spec-hw-slot-ownership §3 is explicit; the slot owns image via image_pin / RUNNER_IMAGES[binary]; the migration folds pre-spec profile.image onto slots; restoring the field would resurrect the dual-owner bug the spec eliminates.

Stale-test group A (~57 failures): ProfileConfig(image='...') constructor calls fail with pydantic ValidationError 'Extra inputs are not permitted' because ProfileConfig is extra='forbid' since 54a5dc68. Affects 16 test files: test_slots_image_pull.py (9), test_container_chat_template.py (8), test_container_mmproj.py (5), test_container_spec_dispatch.py (5), test_container_vision_toggle.py (4), test_container_npu.py (1), test_parallel_batching.py (3), test_qwen3tts_container_spec.py (~9), test_kokoro_container_spec.py (~5), test_container_resolved_detail.py (1), test_device_profile_coherence.py (4), test_model_fit.py (4), test_seed_profiles_migration.py (4), test_apply_plan.py (2), test_recommend.py (3), test_flm.py (1).

Stale-test group B (~66 failures): backend-oriented profile names ('rocm', 'vulkan', 'vulkan-embed', 'vulkan-rerank', 'cpu-llm', 'tts', 'tts-qwen3', 'embed', 'rerank') expected but new seed catalog uses workload keys ('chat', 'embedding', 'reranking', 'cpu-chat', 'kokoro', 'qwen3-tts'). Affects: test_profile_derivation_parity.py (31), test_tts_capability_switch.py (10), NotFound 'profile tts/tts-qwen3 not found' in test_qwen3tts_container_spec.py + test_kokoro_container_spec.py (~13), test_meta_enums.py (1, cpu-llm→cpu-chat), test_install_apply.py (1, rocm/vulkan→chat), test_doctor_profiles.py (2 IndexError because check_profile_images_present correctly returns []), test_orchestrate.py (2), test_model_preferred_profile.py (2), test_schema_npu.py (1), test_gp05_stamped_launch_layering.py (1), test_duplicate_refcount.py (1).

Production code correctness: src/hal0/config/loader.py:525-535 silently drops stray 'image' key from un-migrated profiles.toml before pydantic validation; src/hal0/config/migrations/hw_slot_ownership.py implements spec §6 fold-to-slots with deliberate/debris distinction via STALE_RUNNER_IMAGE_REFS. Both are correct and complete.

Recommended fix path: (1) remove image= kwarg from ProfileConfig(...) helpers across the 16 group-A files, replacing with SlotConfig(image_pin=...) where the test genuinely exercises image plumbing; (2) rename backend profile names to workload keys per spec §10 table across group-B files; (3) tests/updater/test_seed_profiles_migration.py may need to pass image= as raw dict rather than ProfileConfig.model_validate(...) since those tests build pre-migration fixtures; (4) tests/cli/test_doctor_profiles.py's profile-image-missing path is gone by design — rewrite against slot-image check or remove.
